claude-fable-5-2.note: Launch price, 2026-11-09. Mythos 5.2 uses the same rates. Cache reads are 0.025x input. The 1M window has no long-context surcharge. Fast input and output are 2x; prompt-cache multipliers apply on top of that fast input rate: 1.25x 5-minute writes and 0.025x cache reads. https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/fable-5-2/overview https://www.anthropic.com/claude-fable-and-mythos-5-2

claude-fable-5-1.note: Fable 5.1 matches Fable 5 except for cache reads, which dropped to $0.25/M.

claude-mythos-5-1.note: Mythos 5.1 matches Mythos 5 except cache reads at $0.25/M. https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing

claude-opus-5-5.note: No long-context surcharge. Fast input and output are 2x, with the prompt-cache multipliers on top of the fast input rate. https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing

prices.note: Sonnet 5.5 cache reads dropped from $0.20/M to $0.10/M; its other rates held.

claude-sonnet-5.note: The $2/$10 launch price became standard; the rise to $3/$15 scheduled for 2026-09-01 was cancelled.

claude-opus-4-6.note: Fast rates are historical fast-mode rates. Effective usage.speed is authoritative: unsupported requests either failed or reported standard after fallback.

claude-opus-4-7.note: Fast rates are historical fast-mode rates. Effective usage.speed is authoritative: unsupported requests either failed or reported standard after fallback.

claude-haiku-5-5.note: The rate for prompts up to 100k tokens. A larger prompt reprices the whole request at 5x, every rate including cache writes and reads, where a record is one known request.

gpt-6.2-astra.note: Launch price, 2026-11-17. Cache writes are the 30-minute rate. Prompts over 272k use the shared long-context multiplier; fast is 2x. https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6.2-astra

gpt-6.2-sol.note: Launch price, 2026-11-17. Cache writes are the 30-minute rate. Prompts over 272k use the shared long-context multiplier; fast is 2x. https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6.2-sol

gpt-6-astra.note: The default rate, covering the 272k context window Codex runs by default. A larger prompt reprices the whole request at 20/25/2/75 where a record is one known request.

gpt-6.1-sol.note: Same input, cache-write and output rates as GPT-6 Sol; cached input is 5% of input rather than 10%.

gpt-6.1-terra.note: Launch price, 2026-10-26. Cache writes are the 30-minute rate. Prompts over 272k use the shared long-context multiplier; fast is 2x. https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6.1-terra https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing

gpt-5.6-sol.note: GPT-5.6 uses a 1.25x cache-write multiplier and a 90% cache-read discount. Fast mode is twice the standard rates in effect that day, including cache writes and cached input. The unsuffixed id gpt-5.6 routes to this model. https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.6-sol

prices.note: Promotional, announced to hold at least through 2026-11-21. When it lapses, add a period rather than editing this one: usage priced under the promotion must keep its rate.

gpt-5.6-terra.note: GPT-5.6 uses a 1.25x cache-write multiplier and a 90% cache-read discount. Fast mode is twice the standard rates in effect that day. https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing

prices.note: GPT-5.6 Luna and Terra price cut.

gpt-5.6-luna.note: GPT-5.6 uses a 1.25x cache-write multiplier and a 90% cache-read discount. Fast mode is twice the standard rates in effect that day. https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing

prices.note: GPT-5.6 Luna and Terra price cut.

gpt-5.6-cyber.note: Daybreak trusted-access rate. Cache writes are the 30-minute rate; the 12-hour write is $31.25/M. Long-context cells are blank, so there is no long-context tier. https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing

gpt-5.5-cyber-preview.note: Daybreak trusted-access rate. The 30-minute cache-write cell is blank, so cache writes bill as input. Long-context cells are blank, so there is no long-context tier. https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing

gpt-5.5.note: Uses the same >272k tier as the other OpenAI models: 2x input and cached input, 1.5x output (https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.5). Fast is 2.5x and has no long-context rate: the fast card leaves the >272k cells blank, so one request over 272k is served and billed at standard. Cache writes bill as input. https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing https://openai.com/api-fast-mode/ https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/fast-mode

gpt-5.4.note: Fast is 2x but, like GPT-5.5, has no fast long-context rate: one fast request over 272k is billed at standard. Cache writes bill as input. https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing https://openai.com/api-fast-mode/

gpt-5.4-mini.note: Fast mode excludes long context: one fast request over 272k is billed at standard. https://openai.com/api-fast-mode/

gpt-5.4-nano.note: No long-context tier. Cache writes are billed as input. https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing

gpt-5-mini.note: Fast is 1.8x. Cache writes bill as input. https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing https://openai.com/api-fast-mode/

grok-4.5.note: Grok 4.5 fast doubles input and cached input but triples output. The fast rates are those multiples of the standard rates rather than 4.6's absolutes: xAI documents 4.5 cached input at $0.30/M, not 4.6's $0.50/M (https://docs.x.ai/developers/models/grok-4.5), so 2x lands at $0.60/M.

grok-4.6.note: Official Grok 4.6/4.7 short-context rates are $2/M input, $0.50/M cached input, and $6/M output. Fast is 2x the standard short-context token rates. https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing

grok-4.7.note: Official Grok 4.6/4.7 short-context rates are $2/M input, $0.50/M cached input, and $6/M output. Fast is 2x the standard short-context rates. Standard Grok 4.7 doubles at >=200k. Grok 4.7 Fast long context is 1.5x the fast rate once the prompt exceeds 200k ($6 / $1.50 / $18), not a second 2x; at exactly 200k the fast card stays on the short-context rate. Usage through Cursor follows Cursor's own >256k tier, which stays in code. https://docs.x.ai/developers/pricing

gemini-3-flash.note: Gemini 3 Flash Preview at Vertex AI Global endpoint rates; Antigravity does not record the endpoint. No prompt-size tier: the <=200K and >200K columns match. Google lists no cache-write rate, so cache writes bill as input; thinking bills as output. The Vertex card's standard table has no text-output row; the $3/M output rate is the Gemini API card's, which its Priority (1.8x) and Batch (0.5x) rows also imply. https://cloud.google.com/model-garden/pricing https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing

gemini-3.5-flash.note: Vertex AI Global endpoint rates; Antigravity does not record the endpoint. No prompt-size tier. Google lists no cache-write rate, so cache writes bill as input; thinking bills as output. https://cloud.google.com/model-garden/pricing

gemini-3.5-flash-lite.note: Vertex AI Global endpoint rates. No prompt-size tier. Google lists no cache-write rate, so cache writes bill as input; thinking bills as output. https://cloud.google.com/model-garden/pricing

gemini-3.8-flash.note: Introductory price through 2026-12-31, then Google's standard price from 2027-01-01. Vertex AI Global endpoint rates; Antigravity does not record the endpoint. deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017.note: Cursor's model page and the Vertex AI partner-models card both list this flat rate. DeepSeek's own API serves the model as deepseek-flash at the same rate during peak hours and half of it off-peak, which a price period cannot express. kimi-k3.1-pro.note: Priced so the kimi-k3 rule cannot bill K3.1 Pro at K3 rates. Moonshot bills 5-minute cache writes at the input rate and 1-hour writes at $4/M. No long-context tier. https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/pricing/chat

kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed.note: Priced so the kimi-k3.1 rule cannot bill Highspeed at K3.1 Pro rates. Moonshot bills 5-minute cache writes at the input rate and 1-hour writes at $8/M. No long-context tier. https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/pricing/chat
